entities.description: A beige, single-story building with a flat roof and a rectangular window or door opening is visible in the background, partially obscured by a dark vehicle and two soldiers in the foreground.

A male soldier stands in profile facing right, wearing a digital camouflage uniform and a matching helmet with a chin strap. He holds a black assault rifle with a curved magazine across his chest, wearing dark sunglasses and tan combat boots.

A male soldier stands in profile facing right, wearing a digital camouflage uniform, a matching helmet, and dark sunglasses. He holds a black assault rifle with a curved magazine in a ready position, wearing tan combat boots and a black sock visible above the boot.

A male soldier stands in profile facing right, saluting with his right hand to his helmet, wearing a full set of desert camouflage tactical gear including a helmet, sunglasses, and a vest with pouches. He is equipped with a sidearm in a holster on his right hip and wears tan combat boots on a gravel surface with a white van visible in the background.

entities.description: A grey pickup truck is parked in the background, showing its rear quarter panel, tailgate, and rear wheel. The vehicle features a vertical red taillight assembly and a black handle on the tailgate, with a visible mud flap behind the tire.
